subject: QMAN_DIRECTPATH_CORRECTABLE_AER_PORTABLE_COMPONENT
scope: Portable Correctable-only AER policy, config-space projection, reference transitions, structural evidence/receipt replay, and fail-closed admission

implementation.guestWriteBoundary: Classification has no executable physical writes. A factory-only, current-bound, one-use executable plan filters Correctable W1C masks before VFIO and rejects stale or replayed plans.
implementation.guestReadBoundary: Root Status and Correctable Source are projected from one atomic snapshot receipt bound to policy, layout, device, lease, owner, snapshot identity, and authority revision. Requester ID requires guest-visible COR_RCV and a complete 16-bit Source field.
implementation.layoutBoundary: Endpoint and Root Port AER extents, dynamic capability offsets, 4 KiB fit, next-capability ordering, and hidden-chain representability are verified before projection.
stateMachines: guest configuration virtualization and shadow W1C
cleanup, reuse, reset, health, and quarantine
implementation.e4Boundary: Replay requests and receipts bind canonical policy/evidence bytes, exact M24-M29 case artifacts, layout/device/owner generations, nonce, authority revision, and validity windows. Portable verification never promotes the structural receipt to trusted E4 authority.
implementation.admissionBoundary: The structural current-authority receipt additionally binds the current vector and revision+1 CAS under hard budgets. Portable admission always retains TRUSTED_E4_ADAPTER_REQUIRED and cannot return component or product eligibility.

verification.invocationNote: Discovery must run with qman-directpath-core as the working directory. The prior parent-directory command collided with an unrelated top-level tests namespace; README now carries the verified invocation.

limitations: No private Qman repository, real target adapter, or target commit is present.
No real VFIO filter enforcement, IRQ observer, service attribution, device-health observer, physical recovery executor, or physical M29 evidence is present.
No trusted resolver/repository signature root, monotonic authority, durable nonce consumer, authoritative clock, or linearizable CAS implementation is present.
The candidate AER schemas and matrix are not yet in portable normativeSources or the product Case registry.
This receipt cannot close G1-G6, M24-M29, R13, E3, E4, or a release decision.
